The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b482e3ec793c52e0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 10-11. statement: Let (P, ω) be a closed symplectic manifold, and let g : P → P be a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism satisfying g2 = idP . Write Fix(g) = F1 ⊔ · · · ⊔ Fr for its connected fixed components. For each j, choose a smooth Morse function hj : Fj → R. There exists a g-invariant smooth function f : P → R with f|Fj = hj such that, for all sufficiently small ϵ > 0, the map Φϵ = ψϵ ◦ g, HAMILTONIAN FIXED POINTS BELOW THE STABLE MORSE NUMBER 11 where ψs is the Hamiltonian flow of f, satisfies (4.1) Fix(Φϵ) = r G j=1 Crit(hj). Every fixed point of Φϵ is nondegenerate. Moreover, Φϵ is the time-one map of a smooth one- periodic Hamiltonian. If P is simply connected, all its fixed-point loops for this Hamiltonian are contractible.
